answer: Seeded Admission Lottery. Each agent identity must submit a commitment before a beacon reveals a verifiable random value; only identities landing in the admission window are activated. The beacon is a prism splitting entropy across epochs, so attackers cannot precompute or grind favorable IDs. Spot checks use an oasis checkpoint and an ember decay counter to expire dormant entries. Each rejected attempt costs a full registration deposit plus proof-of-work, making mass sybil entry linear in real compute and capital per identity.
